episodes.synopsis: An automata awakens in a basement with no memory or purpose. She is not alone, but her fellow doll sits broken and unresponsive.
episodes.title: The First Melody

episodes.synopsis: During an outing, Haizakura's upbeat attitude clashes with Gekka's more stoic personality. How did the automaton become so cold, and why can't she seem to smile anymore?
episodes.title: Playing Alongside the Moon

episodes.synopsis: Houkiboshi's voice once brought hope to the troops in times of fear and darkness. Now a voice from the past will bring her the same.
episodes.title: Starry Sky Requiem

episodes.synopsis: It's only logical to fix a malfunction, but Karasuba is offended that Haizakura suggested Nagi repair her.
episodes.title: Fluttering Wings Return

episodes.synopsis: An automata's philosophical proof of existence can be measured as such: "I have orders, therefore I am." But if that's true, then what is an automata with no orders at all?
episodes.title: Singing in the Rain

episodes.synopsis: Clients are in short supply after recent incidents involving automata, but Haizakura has an idea to attract new patrons — an idea that requires advice from an unlikely source…
episodes.title: The Black Cat's Concert

episodes.synopsis: While Master Nagi travels abroad on a military mission, the dolls contemplate attending the Capital Fair, and a kindly elderly couple takes a shine to Gekka.
episodes.title: Dreamlike Days

episodes.synopsis: A doll’s duty is never done. After receiving worrisome news, Karasuba and Haizakura venture beyond the walls of the Black Cat on an important mission.
episodes.title: Rondo of Eternal Winter

episodes.synopsis: A lost automata wanders into the path of the Black Cat’s staff, but who exactly is she? They’ve never seen a model quite like Haikagura before…
episodes.title: A Momentary Sextet

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of disaster, Haikagura sleeps, and her origin remains a mystery. While Nagi investigates the mysterious automata, the other dolls prepare for the Capital Fair.
episodes.title: Unending Unison

episodes.synopsis: Two sisters, forged in secret. A successor, made in memory. Fragments of the past and future collide as Haikagura attempts to assume control.
episodes.title: Thunderous War Song

episodes.synopsis: Haizakura knows what she must do to save her friends, but her actions will come at a cost unimaginable. Nevertheless, Haizakura is committed to finding her purpose.
episodes.title: Let These Feelings Resound
